### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.map

### Neovim version

0.12 (!at least latest Nightly build!)

### Description

Typing Control-L in normal mode, with the nvim default mapping, clears the search results (`<Cmd>nohls`). But it does not clear the highlighted lines in the mini map. Those are cleared after `.toggle()`ing the mini map off and on, or `.toggle_focus()`ing into and then out of the mini map window.

Oddly enough, typing `:nohls<CR>` *does* clear the mini map highlights. But using `<C-L>` does not, even though `:nmap <C-L>` shows

```
n  <C-L>       * <Cmd>nohlsearch|diffupdate|normal! <C-L><CR>
                 :help CTRL-L-default
```

### Reproduction

1. Create separate 'nvim-repro' config directory:
    - '~/.config/nvim-repro/' on Unix
    - '~/AppData/Local/nvim-repro/' on Windows

2. Inside 'nvim-repro' directory create a file named 'init.lua'.
   Populate it with the following content:

```lua
 vim.pack.add({
	"https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.map",
})
local map = require('mini.map')
map.setup({
	symbols = {
		encode = map.gen_encode_symbols.dot('4x2'),
	},
	integrations = {
		map.gen_integration.builtin_search(),
	},
})
map.open()
```

3. Run `NVIM_APPNAME=nvim-repro nvim` (i.e. execute `nvim` with `NVIM_APPNAME` environment variable set to "nvim-repro").
   Wait for all dependencies to install.

4. Open a file and search for some text in it. Notice the highlights in the mini map
5. Type `<C-L>`. Notice the highlights disappear in the main window, but remain in the mini map
6. Type  `:MiniMap.toggle()<CR>` twice, and see the highlights are cleared
7. Search again, then type `:nohls<CR>` and see highlights are cleared in both places 
8. Search again, type `<C-L>`, type `:MiniMap.toggle_focus()` twice, and see highlights disappear
9. Type `:nmap <C-L><CR>` to verify that Control-L mapping is set to nvim default

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

I can reproduce. This is both an expected documented behavior and a Neovim issue itself. The integration update is triggered ["... on every change of ‘hlsearch’ ... or `v:hlsearch`"](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-map.html#minimap.gen_integration.builtin_search). Executing `:nohlsearch` does not change 'hlsearch' option, but it does change the value of `v:hlsearch`. However, the assumed way of tracking the `v:hlsearch` change does not work in this case for some reason (I reported it upstream, neovim/neovim#37876).

The reason it is updated after manual `:nohls<CR>` is because there is [an automatic map refresh](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-map.html#mini.map-usage-howautomaticrefreshworks) every time mode changes from any mode to Normal. Which happens in this case: changes from Command-line to Normal.

So I think there is nothing much 'mini.map' itself can do here. What I can suggest as a solution (and what I personally use) is to create a custom mapping (maybe for `<C-l>` itself) that uses `<Cmd>let v:hlsearch = 1 - v:hlsearch<CR>` instead of `<Cmd>nohlsearch<CR>`. This is what is [used in 'mini.basics' with default `\h` left hand side](https://nvim-mini.org/mini.nvim/doc/mini-basics.html#minibasics.config-mappings-mappings.option_toggle_prefix).

title: [mini.map] <C-L> does not clear builtin_search() highlights
